name: xSearch · Round 1
domainSummary: A deliberately simple Manifest V3 browser extension that federated available Confluence, Stack Exchange, Slack, Jira, and Salesforce APIs, normalized responses, and presented aggregated search inside an existing employee workflow.
evidenceBoundary: Do not depict xSearch as a full search platform or imply that it eliminated the external vendor purchase.

researchSources.title: Project walkthrough: xSearch
researchSources.use: Supported source federation, extension delivery, response normalization, scope, and outcome boundary.

assets.name: xSearch · Canonical Amplification
assets.controlledVariable: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette; emphasize federated source adapters
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested at its most resolved supporting-landmark scale. This version emphasizes federated source adapters.

assets.name: xSearch · Process Spine
assets.controlledVariable: recompose the landmark along a clear sequential service spine with repeated but unequal chambers; emphasize Manifest V3 browser integration
assets.thesis: A visible spatial sequence makes the project's process legible without arrows or diagrams. This version emphasizes Manifest V3 browser integration.

assets.name: xSearch · Exchange Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: divide the major functions into unequal connected masses joined by one inhabited structural bridge; emphasize normalized cross-source results
assets.thesis: A physical bridge tests whether handoff and exchange should dominate the identity. This version emphasizes normalized cross-source results.

assets.name: xSearch · Checkpoint Court
assets.controlledVariable: organize the building around a protected validation court with layered thresholds and one decisive exit; emphasize in-workflow operator access
assets.thesis: A central court makes review, validation, or adjudication the primary metaphor. This version emphasizes in-workflow operator access.

assets.name: xSearch · Terraced Escalation
assets.controlledVariable: step the landmark upward through three or four connected terraces toward one compact focus; emphasize bounded internal alternative
assets.thesis: Terraced hierarchy expresses staged progress and increasing commitment. This version emphasizes bounded internal alternative.

assets.name: xSearch · Modular Batch
assets.controlledVariable: build the landmark from repeatable unequal modules locked to one continuous service base; emphasize federated source adapters
assets.thesis: Repeatable modules test batch, scale, and replaceability without detached pieces. This version emphasizes federated source adapters.

assets.name: xSearch · Guarded Recovery
assets.controlledVariable: place a protected core inside redundant connected routes with one visibly joined recovery annex; emphasize Manifest V3 browser integration
assets.thesis: Guardrails and recovery become architectural without implying an unverified implementation. This version emphasizes Manifest V3 browser integration.

assets.name: xSearch · Asymmetric Landmark
assets.controlledVariable: concentrate height and mass off-center to create one singular project-scale skyline; emphasize normalized cross-source results
assets.thesis: A deliberately asymmetric silhouette tests recognition at map scale. This version emphasizes normalized cross-source results.

assets.name: xSearch · Compact Deployment
assets.controlledVariable: compress the domain into the smallest dense, coherent project building that retains the accepted identity; emphasize in-workflow operator access
assets.thesis: Compression tests which visual cues are essential rather than merely decorative. This version emphasizes in-workflow operator access.

assets.name: xSearch · Domain Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance the strongest baseline, process, validation, exchange, and recovery cues in one resolved composition; emphasize bounded internal alternative
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a mature all-around project identity without becoming a city capital. This version emphasizes bounded internal alternative.
